ns2:section.sectionText: Professional Issues - Writing and Speaking for a General Audience This seminar will provide hands-on experience with writing and speaking for an audience outside of your area of research specialization. It is intended for students who already can write competently within their sub-discipline, and it is open to students in all areas of psychology. Requires weekly writing and/or speaking, and will address written formats such as blogging, opinion/editorial writing, book reviewing, and magazine-style feature writing. Speaking will include TED-style science talks as well as talks for non-scientists. Students will provide stylistic, structural, and organizational feedback for their peers. The broader goal is to improve your ability to communicate with people outside of your specialty, a skill that generalizes to giving an effective job talk and to interviewing.
